description: For GTA 6 streamers who want clippers to post their moments on TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels: share Twitch clips free (they appear in the Clip Feed with credit), or fund a self-serve clipping campaign from a US$50 budget plus a 20% fee, paying US$1 to US$5 per 1,000 approved views. Returns the steps, costs and link.
name: get_clipped
title: Get your GTA 6 streams clipped
